visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman wearing a white beret and a beige sweater feeding a deer with green stalks. The setting is an outdoor animal enclosure with a wooden and metal fence. Bright, natural daylight illuminates the scene. Large yellow text overlays are centered on the screen. (2) An aerial drone shot shows a long, straight asphalt bicycle path flanked by a river on one side and a line of coniferous trees on the other. Two cyclists are seen from above moving along the path. The lighting is overcast but clear. (3) The scene shifts to a series of quick cuts: the woman bites into food, a scallion pancake sizzles in a frying pan, and a wide shot of a lush green scallion field. The camera uses close-ups to emphasize the texture of the food and the vibrant green of the crops. (4) The woman is now seen cycling on the same path shown earlier, carrying a pink basket. She smiles and looks around at the scenic green landscape. The camera follows her in a tracking shot, capturing the rows of green trees and the riverbank. (5) The woman enters a theme park area called Waterfront Forest Story, marked by a colorful rainbow-shaped gate. She interacts with various animals including capybaras, goats, and a donkey, feeding them green vegetables. The environment is a mix of wooden structures and water features. (6) Transition to a lush, bright green forest path lined with Taxodium trees. The woman spins and poses on the path. Drone shots capture the scale of the avenue. (7) The scene moves to an urban street with shops and a truck. The woman is shown in a restaurant setting eating a dish of stuffed squid with scallions. Close-ups show the steam and the cross-section of the food. (8) At a vintage-style blue wooden building, people are riding a miniature steam train. The woman waves to the camera. The architecture is rustic and nostalgic. (9) The woman and a man are at a blessing pavilion, pulling out oversized wooden fortune sticks. They laugh and show the text on the sticks to the camera. (10) The final sequence shows more scallion pancakes being prepared and eaten, followed by shots of scallions being harvested from the ground and the woman cycling away into the distance at sunset.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features a diverse range of locations in Yilan, Taiwan, including a scenic riverside bicycle path (Annong Creek), an animal interaction park with rustic fences, a lush green Taxodium forest, a local urban shopping street, a vintage-style railway station with blue wooden siding, and a traditional scallion field with mud and water.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat, rhythmic acoustic guitar strumming and a light drum beat. A cheerful female narrator speaks rapidly with high pitch and enthusiasm. Soft chewing sound effects are heard as she mentions scallions. (2) The music continues as the narrator introduces the location Sanxing. Ambient bird sounds and light wind noise are layered beneath the voiceover. The narrator's speech is punctuated by quick Hard cuts in the audio that match the fast visual editing. (3) A bell chime SFX rings when a location pin is mentioned. The female narrator's voice remains dominant and energetic. A faint 'please eat' vocalization from a different voice appears briefly. (4) The music swells slightly in volume during the aerial shots. The narrator describes the scenery with a high-pitched, melodic contour. Low-level ambient sounds of the park environment, including distant water and chatter, can be heard. (5) As the woman interacts with the donkey, a soft snorting or animal sound is audible. The music maintains a constant, happy tempo. The narrator's tone is warm and inviting. (6) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX is used between the park and restaurant scenes. The narrator introduces the stuffed squid dish with a slightly slower, more emphasized speech rate to convey deliciousness. (7) Loud munching and crunching sound effects accompany the close-up shots of eating. The narrator expresses excitement and satisfaction through vocal inflections. (8) At the railway park, the sound of a train whistle and mechanical clacking is added as a background layer. Laughter from a male and female voice is clearly audible as they pull out the fortune sticks. (9) The narrator returns to a rapid-fire speech style for the final scallion pancake review. The music reaches its climax with a full rhythmic arrangement. (10) The audio concludes with a friendly sign-off from the narrator, maintaining a high arousal level until the track fades out quickly at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a travel guide and promotional vlog for a day trip to Sanxing, Yilan. It combines scenic outdoor activities (cycling) with animal tourism and local culinary specialties (scallions) to create an appealing, high-energy itinerary for young travelers.
